meta.name: tool-calling-tutor
meta.description: Use when a tool-calling agent does not call a tool, sends wrong arguments, loops without stopping, or needs a function schema. Guides a four-branch diagnosis and five-step schema repair. Do not use for framework-specific, MCP-server, or production-observability questions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定位AI不调用工具或卡死循环的根因并修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发AI智能体,且常遇到工具调用出错或卡循环。
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose and fix AI agent tool-calling failures and loops.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build AI agents and often see tool-calling errors or endless loops.

howto.what: 装上后，若用户遇到工具调用问题，Claude会先问四种症状中的哪一种，再按对应分支引导诊断（如检查description、参数schema、循环控制），并指引用户参考示例代码，而非直接代写代码。
howto.when: 当用户说“工具没被调用”“参数传错”“循环停不下来”等，或需要设计函数schema时触发。

say.text: 我的LLM不调用我的工具，该查哪里？
工具被调用了但参数类型不对，怎么修？
say.note: Claude会对照schema进化例子给出4个改进点。

say.text: 从零设计一个函数schema，步骤是什么？
say.note: Claude会带你走5步法并让你fork模板。

howto.what_en: When the user reports a tool-calling issue, Claude first asks which of four symptoms applies, then guides diagnosis per branch (description, parameter schema, loop control), pointing to reference examples rather than writing code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions a tool not called, wrong arguments, endless looping, or asks for a function schema.

say_en.text: My LLM won't call my tool. Where should I look?
say_en.note: Claude follows branch (a) to check description and tool boundaries.

say_en.text: The tool is called but arguments are wrong. How do I fix it?
say_en.note: Claude walks through the 4-step schema evolution.

say_en.text: How do I design a function schema from scratch?
say_en.note: Claude walks the 5-step method and suggests forking a starter.
